description: Re-send a captured request to a local target (no tunnel round-trip, no credits). Optionally override method/path/headers/body or edit individual JSON body fields via set (e.g. ["data.amount=999"]). The exchange is appended to the capture log.

resign.description: Re-sign the edited body with this provider scheme (needs secret) so the handler still accepts it

set.description: Edit JSON body fields before sending, each "path=value" e.g. "data.amount=999"

subdomain.description: Session whose capture log to replay from

target.description: host:port to send to (defaults to the running tunnel daemon's target)

name: request_replay
title: Replay a captured request
